result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Art. 3, Divisions 39 and 41) covering cardroom regulations and casino party licensing, retrieved from a page whose URL suggests an algorithmic rent-pricing division that is not actually in the text.
result.notes: This part contains only cardroom (Division 39, \u00a7\u00a733.3911-33.3923) and casino party (Division 41, \u00a7\u00a733.4101-33.4106) provisions, which are business regulation and gaming rules outside the six rental-housing categories. The source URL refers to San Diego's Division 11 on prohibition of anti-competitive automated rent price fixing (\u00a798.1103), but that text does not appear in this part of the document, so no algorithmic_rent_setting rule is extracted. No rental-housing rules found.
